name: Kawasaki (Fukuoka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kawasaki town emblem in black: a ring open at the top enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kawasaki, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 March 1988.

features.role: Kawasaki town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing three vertical bars
